items.title: Stripe Uses Graph Search and State Machines to Automate Database Remediation
items.zh_title: Stripe用图搜索与状态机自动化数据库修复
items.summary: The engineering team at Stripe recently described how they automated database incident recovery by modeling their global infrastructure as a graph. items.title: Presentation: Keeping ChatGPT Fast as AI Development Accelerates
items.zh_title: 保持ChatGPT快速：AI开发加速下的性能优化
items.summary: Martin Spier explains how agentic workflows dramatically increase code change volume at OpenAI. By Martin Spier

items.title: Cloudflare's Precursor Detects Bots and AI Agents Through Continuous Behavioral Analysis
items.zh_title: Cloudflare Precursor通过持续行为分析检测机器人与AI代理
items.summary: Cloudflare recently introduced Precursor, a client-side behavioral analysis engine that continuously evaluates session interactions, such as mouse movements and keyboard timing, to improve detection of sophisticated bots and AI agents without relying solely on one-time challenges like CAPTCHAs. items.zh_summary: Cloudflare推出Precursor客户端行为分析引擎，通过持续评估鼠标移动和键盘输入节奏等会话交互，增强对复杂机器人和AI代理的检测能力，不再仅依赖CAPTCHA等一次性挑战。该方案由Renato Losio报道。
items.reason: 数据从业者需关注AI代理流量识别技术，以优化数据采集与反作弊策略。

In this post, we walk through installing the managing-amazon-msk and migrate-to-msk skills and demonstrate how they diagnose performance issues, size clusters with cost breakdowns, and plan migrations from self-managed Kafka to Amazon MSK.
items.zh_summary: Agent Skills for Amazon MSK带来具备代理类型感知的专业技能，用于运维和迁移Apache Kafka集群。文章演示了安装managing-amazon-msk和migrate-to-msk技能，并展示其诊断性能问题、按成本拆分规划集群规模，以及规划从自管理Kafka迁移到Amazon MSK。
items.reason: 数据从业者可利用Agent Skills自动化Kafka集群运维与迁移，降低复杂性和成本。

items.title: Introducing Apache Spark troubleshooting agent for Amazon EMR on EKS
items.zh_title: Amazon EMR on EKS推出Apache Spark故障排查Agent
items.summary: In this post, we show you how to set up the agent for Amazon EMR on EKS and walk through troubleshooting a failed job run. We demonstrate the workflow from both the Amazon EMR console and an AI assistant that supports the Model Context Protocol (MCP), an open standard for connecting AI assistants to external tools and data.
items.zh_summary: 本文介绍如何为Amazon EMR on EKS设置Apache Spark故障排查Agent，并演示排查失败作业的流程。该Agent可通过Amazon EMR控制台或支持模型上下文协议（MCP）的AI助手调用，MCP是连接AI助手与外部工具和数据的开放标准。
items.reason: 数据从业者可利用该Agent与AI助手快速定位Spark作业失败原因，提升大数据平台运维效率。

items.title: Upgrade Amazon Redshift DC2 clusters to the new Amazon Redshift RG
items.zh_title: 升级Amazon Redshift DC2集群至RG实例
items.summary: Upgrading your Amazon Redshift DC2 clusters to AWS Graviton-based RG instances unlocks managed storage, data sharing, zero-ETL, and an integrated data lake engine. This post covers the new features, node-mapping guidance for sizing, the available upgrade methods, and how to validate your target configuration with Amazon Redshift Test Drive.
items.zh_summary: 将Amazon Redshift DC2集群升级至基于AWS Graviton的RG实例，可解锁托管存储、数据共享、零ETL和集成数据湖引擎。本文介绍新功能、节点映射调整指南、可用升级方法，以及如何通过Amazon Redshift Test Drive验证目标配置。
items.reason: 数据从业者需了解Redshift新实例的升级路径与功能收益，以优化数据平台架构与性能。

items.zh_title: 生成式AI如何交付高管所需的周一晨报洞察
items.summary: A VP of Sales at a major CPG has three decks open before her first coffee. One from...
items.zh_summary: 文章以一位快消品销售副总裁为例，描述她在早晨喝咖啡前要打开三份报告的场景，探讨生成式AI如何自动整合数据并生成高管所需的洞察报告。内容聚焦于用AI减少人工汇总、提升决策效率，涉及自然语言生成与数据分析的结合。产品与具体数字在原文中未明确提及，但核心场景属于数据智能与商业智能范畴。

items.title: Ingest semi-structured data faster and more efficiently with Variant - Now Generally Available
items.zh_title: Variant正式GA：加速半结构化数据摄取
items.summary: For years, ingesting semi-structured data like JSON, XML, or CSV meant a difficult...
items.zh_summary: Variant现已全面上市，可更快速高效地摄取JSON、XML或CSV等半结构化数据。该功能解决了传统摄取方式复杂繁琐的问题，显著提升了数据处理效率。Variant针对多变数据格式优化了解析与加载流程，降低开发与运维成本。适用于AI数据平台及数据管道场景，帮助团队加速数据准备。
items.reason: 数据从业者需高效处理半结构化数据，Variant的GA可直接提升数据摄取效率，降低工程负担，值得关注。

items.zh_summary: 该工具提供了一个支持110种数据库系统的在线实验环境，用户可自由选择任意数据库执行查询、建表、插入数据等操作。每个数据库均预加载了1亿条记录的数据集，方便进行示例查询测试。该平台不仅支持基础操作，还覆盖多种数据库类型，适合数据从业者评估和比较不同数据库的性能与功能。
items.reason: 数据从业者可借此快速体验和对比主流数据库系统，辅助技术选型与性能测试，提升数据平台建设效率。

items.title: Andy Pavlo joins ClickHouse to establish ClickHouse Labs
items.zh_title: Andy Pavlo加入ClickHouse成立Labs研究团队
items.summary: I am excited to announce that I am joining ClickHouse, Inc. to establish and lead a new research team at ClickHouse Labs.
items.zh_summary: 知名数据库学者Andy Pavlo宣布加入ClickHouse公司，负责建立并领导ClickHouse Labs的新研究团队。该团队将聚焦数据库系统前沿技术研究，旨在推动ClickHouse在数据存储与查询性能上的进一步突破。Pavlo的学术背景和行业影响力预计将为ClickHouse带来更多技术创新和生态拓展。
items.reason: 数据从业者应关注ClickHouse在数据库研究上的新动向，可能影响未来数据平台技术路线与性能演进。

items.title: ClickHouse launches ClickHouse Labs with Andy Pavlo as VP of Database Research
items.zh_title: ClickHouse成立实验室，Andy Pavlo出任数据库研究副总裁
items.summary: Renowned database researcher will lead a new group dedicated to advancing foundational database technology and sharing its work openly with the broader community.
items.zh_summary: ClickHouse宣布成立ClickHouse Labs，由知名数据库研究者Andy Pavlo担任数据库研究副总裁。该实验室将专注于推进基础数据库技术，并公开分享研究成果。此举有望加速ClickHouse在数据分析与AI领域的底层能力创新，强化其技术领导地位。
items.reason: 数据从业者需关注数据库核心技术演进，Andy Pavlo的加入与实验室成立预示ClickHouse在性能与架构上的重要突破，可能影响数据平台选型。
